verdict: Paid ads remain off; organic profile is active but not converting calls.
narrative: This period, no paid spend ran on Meta or Google — ads are off, not underperforming, and no leads were generated through those channels. Your Google Business Profile showed genuine activity, with 81 direction requests across 25 active days, but the profile produced zero calls and zero website clicks despite 90 impressions, pointing to a broken or missing call button that is being corrected now. In the pipeline, 11 contacts and 8 opportunities were recorded this period, but none have moved to a won stage or booked appointment, and the intake-to-close path is being verified as part of the broader build-out. Several setup milestones — including payment path verification and the end-to-end system test — are overdue and are the current priority before paid channels relaunch. Once those are resolved and ads go live, you should see leads and cost-per-lead figures return to the report.
